provenance.artifact_first_seen_commit_message: V229 FlyWire morphology recovery and V230 synapse coordinates

codex_documented_fafb_connection_thresho.interpretation: V230 observed minimum of 5 rows per pre/post pair is consistent with the documented FAFB connectivity threshold, but this does not prove the historical V230 extraction used that rule.

exact_coordinate_probe.reason: Programmatic FlyWire/CAVE access requires an access token in the execution environment.

direct_codex_coordinate_proof.interpretation: Every V230 row is an exact tuple match in the official Codex FAFB v783 individual-synapse coordinate data product.

connection_count_proof.interpretation: The 649 individual coordinate rows exactly expand the 75 selected directed connections in Codex v783; each pair count is identical.

frozen_zenodo_correspondence.note: Independent frozen-source corroboration: V230 coordinates equal the component-wise midpoint of canonical pre/post positions for all 649 rows.

provenance.deterministic_pair_selection_rule: incident to one of the four target roots in Codex FAFB v783 connections.csv.gz; aggregate syn_count by directed pair
provenance.threshold_note: Historical use of a >=5 filter is not proven. For this target neighborhood, thresholds 1 through 5 all produce the same 75-pair set; threshold 6 reduces the set to 57 pairs.

observations: All 75 observed pre/post pairs contain at least 5 coordinate rows.
The four V229 target roots occur as postsynaptic roots, but 34 additional postsynaptic roots are also present.
V230 is exactly reproduced from Codex FAFB v783 synapse_coordinates.csv.gz for all 649 rows.
All 75 V230 directed pairs have exact aggregate synapse counts in Codex FAFB v783 connections.csv.gz, totaling 649.
Independent Zenodo FAFB v783 Feather analysis also reconstructs all 649 V230 coordinates as component-wise midpoints of the canonical pre/post points.
The original historical V230 producer script is not preserved in Git history; the exact public-data reconstruction path is nevertheless established.
The exact 75-pair set is deterministically reproduced by selecting all directed pairs incident to the four target roots in Codex FAFB v783 connections.csv.gz.
inference_not_proof: The repository does not preserve the original historical command that selected the 75 directed pairs.
Completeness is proven for the 75 selected pairs, not as a claim that V230 represents the entire brain-wide synapse dataset.
